query: What happens if I have incentives accrued across a few months but only paid later? When will the payments attract CPF contribution?
reference_answer: Platform earnings and incentives attract CPF contribution when they are due and payable, not when they are accrued.For example, the CPF contributions on an incentive payment in June that is for trips done in May will be computed together with the rest of the June earnings.

To support lower-income platform workers during this period, we will provide the Platform Workers CPF Transition Support (PCTS) to help mitigate the drop in take-home earnings. answer: If you have accrued incentives over several months but only paid later, these payments will attract CPF contribution when they become due and payable, typically with the rest of your earnings in the month they are paid, according to [Document 1]. Payments meant to supplement your earnings, like incentives, attract CPF contribution when they are due, regardless of when they were accrued, as per [Document 1] and [Document 2].
